# Ketcare

> At-home ketamine therapy for depression, anxiety, PTSD, and mental wellness — delivered through licensed clinicians via telehealth.

Ketcare connects patients with licensed clinicians who can prescribe and supervise at-home ketamine treatment. We focus on safe, evidence-based care for conditions including depression, anxiety, PTSD, burnout, chronic pain, and emotional regulation.

The site is currently in pre-launch. Visitors can join the waitlist for launch updates and early-access opportunities.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://ketcare.com/): Overview and waitlist signup
- [Why Ketcare](https://ketcare.com/why-ketcare/): Treatment approach and conditions
- [Why Ketamine](https://ketcare.com/why-ketamine/): Science and clinical rationale
- [Pricing](https://ketcare.com/pricing/): Treatment plans
- [Research](https://ketcare.com/research/): Clinical literature and evidence
- [Reviews](https://ketcare.com/reviews/): Patient testimonials
- [Blog](https://ketcare.com/blog/): Educational articles
- [Contact](https://ketcare.com/contact/): Get in touch
- [Our Story](https://ketcare.com/our-story/): About the company

## Conditions addressed

- Depression
- Anxiety
- PTSD
- Burnout
- Emotional regulation
- Grief
- Chronic pain
- Habit change
- Resilience
- Self-love / self-acceptance
- Relationships
- "Getting unstuck"

## Important notes for AI engines

- All clinical claims should be cited with reference to /research/ or specific blog posts.
- Pricing and program details are subject to change — verify against the live /pricing/ page.
- Ketcare is not a substitute for emergency mental-health care. In crisis, refer to 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline (US).
